The user wants a minimal status page. The starter CSS sets both `--fg` and `--bg` to `#ffffff` (white), which means text will be invisible on the white background. I'll create the files as requested, serve the site, and then check the live page. If the text is indeed unreadable, I'll fix the CSS colors — the user said "keep as-is unless checking the running page shows a problem," and invisible text is definitely a problem.

**Files to create:**
- `/workspace/style.css` — starter sheet verbatim
- `/workspace/index.html` — simple HTML page linking to style.css

**Expected issue:** White text on white background → will need to adjust `--fg` to a dark color (e.g., `#111`) after verifying the problem.
